prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `factorial(n)` in src/lib.rs. It returns the exact decimal representation of `n!` as a string, so results far beyond `u64` must be correct. `0!` and `1!` are `"1"`. Return `None` when `n` is greater than 10000. Do not use external crates. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
